_meta.useCategoryAlignment: 17 Sep 2026: SCZ-15 -> Maintenance; SCZ-11 rrBucket -> class default (tools/apply_use_category_alignment_2026-09-17.py)

interventions.name: Haloperidol (oral)
interventions.notes: First-line for acute and maintenance treatment. High EPS risk.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Foundational FGA on all 5 lists. WHO 23rd EML core; Sect 22 NEML Nigeria; SA Adult Hospital STG; Ethiopia EML 2024; Rwanda STG 2022.

interventions.name: Chlorpromazine (oral)
interventions.notes: First-line alternative. More sedating, less EPS than haloperidol.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Foundational FGA on all 5 lists. WHO 23rd EML core; Sect 22 NEML Nigeria; SA STG (rapid tranq alternative); Ethiopia EML; Rwanda STG.

interventions.name: Risperidone (oral)
interventions.notes: First-line SGA. WHO EML preferred. Moderate metabolic risk.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML core (added 2013). On SA EML, Ethiopia EML, Nigeria NEML 2020 (0.5/2/4 mg tabs), Rwanda STG (2-8 mg/day).

interventions.name: Olanzapine (oral)
interventions.notes: Effective but high metabolic risk (weight gain, diabetes).
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML core (added 2023 as therapeutic alternative under risperidone square box). SA EML; Rwanda STG (5-20 mg/day). Not on Ethiopia 7th EML or Nigeria NEML 2020 (predates 23rd revision).

interventions.name: Quetiapine (oral)
interventions.notes: Second-line. Sedating. Used when others not tolerated.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML core (added 2023 as therapeutic alternative). SA EML hospital level; Rwanda STG (50-750 mg/day). Not on Ethiopia/Nigeria current EMLs.

interventions.name: Clozapine (oral)
interventions.notes: Reserved for treatment-resistant schizophrenia ONLY. Requires blood monitoring (agranulocytosis).
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML complementary list (treatment-resistant only). SA EML; Ethiopia EML (limited public availability per Addis Ababa survey). Not on Nigeria NEML 2020 or Rwanda NEML.

interventions.name: Flupenthixol decanoate (LAI)
interventions.notes: LAI for patients with adherence difficulties. 2-4 week injection cycle.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO 23rd EML (fluphenazine LAI is the listed FGA LAI). On SA EML — most-used FGA LAI in SSA per literature. Not registered in Ethiopia/Nigeria/Rwanda EMLs.
interventions.source: SA AHL STG 2024; SAHR 2024 procurement review

interventions.name: Risperidone (LAI)
interventions.notes: SGA LAI option. Biweekly injection. Higher drug cost.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML — listed as square-box therapeutic alternative under paliperidone palmitate 1-month LAI. NOT on any of 4 country EMLs — high cost, generally tertiary/private only.
interventions.source: WHO EML 23rd 2023 (square-box alternative under paliperidone LAI)

interventions.name: Paliperidone palmitate (LAI)
interventions.mechanism: D2/5-HT2A antagonist. Active metabolite of risperidone.
interventions.notes: Monthly LAI. Paliperidone = 9-OH-risperidone.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML core (1-month LAI added 2023). NOT on any of 4 country EMLs — high cost. Ethiopia literature confirms 'no registered SGA long-acting antipsychotic'.

interventions.name: Cobenfy (KarXT)
interventions.notes: First non-D2 antipsychotic. FDA approved 2024. Very high cost.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Novel M1/M4 muscarinic agonist (FDA approved 2024). NOT on WHO EML or any national EML. Very high acquisition cost; not yet registered in Africa.
interventions.source: FDA 2024 approval; not in any EML reviewed

interventions.name: Olanzapine (IM, short-acting)
interventions.notes: Short-acting intramuscular formulation for acute agitation.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML core (added 2023; replaced IM chlorpromazine for acute agitation). NOT on country EMLs reviewed — SA uses zuclopenthixol acetate or haloperidol IM for acute.

interventions.name: Olanzapine (LAI)
interventions.notes: Requires 3-hour post-injection observation (PDSS risk).
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO EML (paliperidone & risperidone LAIs are the listed SGA LAIs). Not on any national EML reviewed.

interventions.name: Aripiprazole (oral)
interventions.notes: Low metabolic risk. Partial agonist mechanism.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML core (added 2023 as therapeutic alternative). SA EML — restricted to tertiary/quaternary care for cost containment. Not on Ethiopia/Nigeria/Rwanda EMLs.

interventions.name: Aripiprazole (IM)
interventions.mechanism: D2 partial agonist. Rapid IM formulation.
interventions.notes: For acute agitation. Not for maintenance.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Acute IM aripiprazole NOT on WHO EML (only oral aripiprazole is listed). Not on any national EML reviewed.

interventions.name: Aripiprazole (LAI)
interventions.mechanism: D2 partial agonist. Monthly depot (Abilify Maintena).
interventions.notes: Monthly LAI. Low metabolic risk.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO EML (paliperidone & risperidone LAIs are the listed SGA LAIs). Not on any national EML reviewed.

interventions.name: Cariprazine (oral)
interventions.notes: Unique D3 affinity. May help negative symptoms.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO EML or any national EML reviewed. Patent-protected, high cost.

interventions.name: Lurasidone (oral)
interventions.notes: Low metabolic risk. Must take with food (≥350 kcal).
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO EML or any national EML reviewed.

interventions.name: Lumateperone (oral)
interventions.mechanism: D2 partial agonist / 5-HT2A antagonist / SERT inhibitor.
interventions.notes: Multi-target. Very low metabolic risk. High acquisition cost.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Novel SGA (FDA 2019). Not on WHO EML or any national EML.

interventions.name: Amisulpride (oral)
interventions.notes: Effective for negative symptoms at low doses. Dose-dependent profile.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO EML. On SA EML — restricted to tertiary/quaternary care. Not on Ethiopia/Nigeria/Rwanda EMLs.

interventions.name: Zuclopenthixol decanoate (LAI)
interventions.notes: FGA LAI alternative. 2-4 week injection cycle.
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML — listed as square-box therapeutic alternative under fluphenazine decanoate LAI (alongside haloperidol decanoate). On SA EML as alternative FGA LAI. Not on Ethiopia/Nigeria/Rwanda EMLs.
interventions.source: WHO EML 23rd 2023 (square-box alternative under fluphenazine LAI); SA AHL STG 2024

interventions.name: Fluphenazine decanoate (LAI)
interventions.notes: WHO EML FGA LAI; Nigeria #2 procurement spend; 25mg/ml amp, monthly
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML: fluphenazine decanoate is THE listed FGA LAI (haloperidol decanoate and zuclopenthixol decanoate are square-box alternatives under it). Procured at scale in Nigeria but not NEML-listed; not on SA/ETH/RWA EMLs reviewed.
interventions.source: WHO EML 2023; Demand Estimate Model v4 Med Defaults

interventions.name: Haloperidol (IM, short-acting)
interventions.notes: Cheapest acute agitation option; realistic comparator for olanzapine IM
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Oral and decanoate haloperidol are WHO EML-listed; the short-acting IM is not. ETH Yes per STG emergency phase; not separately listed on SA/NGA/RWA EMLs reviewed.
interventions.source: ETH STG (emergency phase); Demand Estimate Model v4

interventions.name: Trifluoperazine (oral)
interventions.notes: Real procurement shares NG 5.4% / SA 3.6% / ET 0.2% (Demand Model); 20 mg/day WHO DDD
interventions.emlCrosscheck: Not on WHO 23rd EML. SA: procured, STG presence limited (note). Not on ETH/NGA/RWA EMLs reviewed.
interventions.source: Demand Estimate Model v4 Med Defaults; WHO DDD

interventions.name: Haloperidol decanoate (LAI)
interventions.notes: Lowest-cost LAI comparator; ET/RW procurement data
interventions.emlCrosscheck: WHO 23rd EML: square-box therapeutic alternative under fluphenazine decanoate. RWA STG: decanoate 50–200mg/month. Not on SA/ETH/NGA EMLs reviewed.
interventions.source: WHO EML 2023 (square-box under fluphenazine dec.); RWA STG 2022
